article.title: What is Haitian food like in the United States?
article.excerpt: As late as the 1990s, food in Haiti probably was the best in the Caribbean, and it certainly was regarded as such. There were fancy French-Caribbean fusion restaurants in Petitionville with amazing seafood, and there was high quality street and diner-level food in Port-au-Prince.
